mathematics.assertion_tested: List-based Python recorder agrees exactly with an independent dictionary lifecycle oracle for every declared bounded command word; actual Lean recorder agrees with Python on the declared subrange and focused scenarios; malformed inputs and resource excesses reject; pending operations globally prevent terminal-log export to the inherited calibration parser.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact natural-number identifiers and finite strings/Boolean flags; no floating arithmetic or stochastic simulation.
mathematics.conventions: Every request starts empty. Begin reserves one operation identity, terminal completion removes its pending entry and appends one immutable event. Exact replay and late same-key begin are no-ops. Conflicting reuse and unregistered finish reject at their zero-based index, with no returned snapshot. Log order is terminal completion order. Success/rejection count as binary reports; faults do not. Registry identities must be injective.
inputs: All command words of length 0 through 4 over IDs 0,1 and keys 0,1, using begin and finish with success/rejection/fault
All command words of length 0 through 3 compared with actual Lean, plus twelve explicit focused scenarios
Twenty structural host rejections, seven raw JSON rejection probes, exact input and aggregate resource boundary checks
Synthetic complete and pending two-identity snapshots mapped to protected nine-field quote identities
non_claims: No universal refinement theorem follows from bounded Python/Lean comparisons.
No authenticated durable log, actual checker evidence, paid operation, retry, or sampling law is created or validated.

The raw recorder accepts caller-supplied terminal statuses. The formal reveal theorem concerns a constructed next-bit model; correspondence of arbitrary raw recorder input with that model is not established.
Readiness means no pending operation, not enough calibration samples or a valid calibrated policy.
